metadata.title: Evidence-gated abstention and selective prediction risk
metadata.research_question: Does abstaining from proposals with incomplete evidence provenance improve accepted-proposal reliability, and at what coverage cost?
metadata.split_protocol: Same deterministic scenario-level split procedure as E1; all records from a scenario remain in one partition.
metadata.proposal_source: GraphReasoner selected typed paths; no LLM proposals.

traceability_score_definition.formula: present required metadata fields / all required metadata fields across selected path edges
traceability_score_definition.interpretation: Evidence metadata completeness only; not calibrated confidence or probability of correctness.

metadata.unsupported_definition: Accepted proposal whose selected path is absent or has no edge containing both non-empty evidence text and a scenario_id or source_id.
metadata.selective_risk_definition: 1 - micro selective precision among accepted proposals.
metadata.coverage_definition: Fraction of test queries with at least one accepted proposal.
